reports.notes.activity_retention: Based on the activity log, which is kept for one year. Older changes are not available.
reports.notes.carrier_fees_zero: Delivery and return fees are zero on new statements: the courier already takes their fee from the cash at the door.
reports.notes.category_overlap: A product in several categories counts in each, so category rows do not add up to the period total.
reports.notes.current_cost_basis: COGS is calculated at the current cost price, not the cost at the time of sale. Cost changes are audit-logged.
reports.notes.entity_history_sources: Order status changes are kept permanently; other field changes come from the activity log and are kept for one year.
reports.notes.free_text_reason: Reasons are free text, so grouping is only as consistent as what was typed. Outcome is the reliable grouping.
reports.notes.line_value_basis: Line values are the amount ordered, not a share of cash collected — a payment cannot be split across lines.
reports.notes.low_stock_threshold: "Low" uses the same threshold as the system's low-stock alerts. Override it above to explore other levels.
reports.notes.min_units_guard: Only products with returns are listed. Raise the minimum units to hide low-volume noise.
reports.notes.net_of_shipping: Collections are net of shipping — the courier keeps their fee at the door, so it never reaches a treasury.
reports.notes.phase_c_boundary: Orders settled before the net-collection change recorded the gross amount, so figures may differ across that date.
reports.notes.reservation_variance: Any non-zero variance means reserved stock does not match its movements and should be investigated.
reports.notes.revenue_on_delivery: Revenue is recognised on delivery, the same point at which stock deducts. A confirmed order is not yet revenue.
reports.notes.shipping_not_pnl: Shipping is not a profit-and-loss line — the customer pays the courier directly, so it is shown as a memo only.
reports.notes.treasury_variance: Variance compares the replayed balance against the stored one. It is expected to be non-zero for a past period.
